front.title: Robert Pattinson is cast as James Bond
front.tldr: Robert Pattinson has been cast as James Bond. The actor called it a 'dream come true' today, describing 007 as one of the most legendary characters in cinema.

front.title: Hands-on with the iPhone Duo's new face unlock
front.tldr: Apple's iOS 27.3 beta 2 adds a way to unlock the foldable iPhone Duo with its front camera, partially solving a common complaint about the device. MacRumors tried it out ahead of release.

front.title: OpenAI gives 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to its AI models
front.tldr: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers programme to give 200,000 scientists worldwide free access to its frontier models.

stories.title: How 1,800 scientists are using ChatGPT in research
stories.tldr: OpenAI surveyed more than 1,800 scientists on how they use ChatGPT in research, looking at daily workflows, productivity and expectations for scientific discovery.

stories.title: AI cybersecurity startup Corma hits $1bn valuation in three months
stories.tldr: AI cybersecurity startup Corma has raised a $125 million Series A led by NEA, reaching a $1 billion valuation just three months after launching its product.

stories.title: The King's Trust and OpenAI launch £1m partnership for young people
stories.tldr: The King's Trust and OpenAI have launched a £1 million partnership to help up to 25,000 young people across the UK build practical AI skills for work.

stories.title: Google Maps can now build full holiday trip itineraries
stories.tldr: New Ask Maps features let you plan holiday road trips, get route tips, find local appointments and search your saved lists.

stories.title: Meta tests Direct, a standalone Instagram messaging app
stories.tldr: Meta is testing Direct, a standalone direct-messaging app for Instagram, currently available only in Turkey and Thailand.

stories.title: Island turns cutting your screen time into a farming game
stories.tldr: YC-backed app Island turns screen-time goals into a farming game, rewarding users with new crops and animals when they stick to their limits.

stories.title: Tesla puts €3bn into Berlin gigafactory for Cybercab production
stories.tldr: Tesla is putting Europe on its Cybercab roadmap with a €3 billion expansion of its Berlin gigafactory.

stories.title: iPhone Duo's alarms and calls get quieter with iOS 27.3
stories.tldr: Apple's next iOS update brings one of Face ID's quieter features to the iPhone Duo, making alarms, timers and phone calls less disruptive.

stories.title: Twice as many apps are now optimised for the iPhone Duo
stories.tldr: Apple says the number of iPhone Duo-optimised apps on the App Store has doubled since it last reported the figure, according to marketing chief Greg Joswiak.

stories.title: Apple News+ puzzles are coming to the UK
stories.tldr: Apple News+ puzzles are expanding to subscribers in the UK, Australia and French Canada with the 27.3 software updates.

stories.title: Apple TV lands two Grammy nominations for 'Schmigadoon!' and 'Widow's Bay'
stories.tldr: Apple TV picked up two Grammy nominations, one of them for the cancelled musical comedy 'Schmigadoon!', an unlikely awards success story.

stories.title: Brad Pitt explains why Leonardo DiCaprio's cameo fell through
stories.tldr: Brad Pitt told the Hollywood Reporter at the LA premiere that a Rick Dalton cameo from Leonardo DiCaprio in the Cliff Booth sequel would have needed too many prosthetics.

stories.title: Christopher Nolan could help save physical media next
stories.tldr: Best Buy is returning to physical media sales with 'The Odyssey', and Christopher Nolan may end up helping save the format just as he helped save cinemas.

stories.title: Del Toro's Frankenstein director's cut changes the film with one scene
stories.tldr: A newly released director's cut of Guillermo del Toro's 'Frankenstein' adds just eight extra minutes, but one new scene changes how the whole film plays.

stories.title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' returns to cinemas with new scenes in December
stories.tldr: The re-release of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day', with previously unseen footage, hits theatres on 4 December. Tickets go on sale 19 November.

stories.title: 'Minotaur' review: Zvyagintsev's riveting comeback
stories.tldr: Andrey Zvyagintsev, director of 'Loveless' and 'Leviathan', returns with an adultery thriller that reworks familiar territory into something IndieWire calls engrossing and icily gripping.

stories.title: Magic end Celtics' six-game win streak with 115-105 win
stories.tldr: Orlando rallied in the fourth quarter to beat Boston 115-105 on the back end of a back-to-back, ending the Celtics' six-game winning streak. Jayson Tatum had 24 points and 12 rebounds.

stories.title: Celtics set franchise record for first-quarter lead in Mavericks blowout
stories.tldr: The Celtics set a franchise record for a first-quarter lead against the Mavericks, the widest margin seen in an NBA game after one quarter since 1987.

stories.title: Patriots' Drake Maye could miss an extended period with leg injury
stories.tldr: Drake Maye exited Sunday's loss in Munich in the first quarter and did not return. The Patriots fear he has suffered a significant lower leg injury.

stories.title: Patriots blown out 35-10 by Lions in Germany
stories.tldr: The Lions, led by running back Jahmyr Gibbs, routed the Patriots 35-10 in Germany, with the game effectively over long before the final whistle.

stories.title: What's still left to fight for in F1 2026
stories.tldr: Kimi Antonelli has already secured his maiden title as Formula 1's youngest world champion, but a five-way battle for second place in the standings is still open.

stories.title: Williams and Aston Martin reveal special liveries for Las Vegas GP
stories.tldr: Both teams have revamped their cars for this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix, F1's third and final US race of the season.

stories.title: F1 poised to take crucial step towards V8 engines' return
stories.tldr: Formula 1 manufacturers were set to back new regulations on Monday, a step towards bringing V8 engines back to the sport.

stories.title: The Red Sox prospects who need protecting before Tuesday's 40-man deadline
stories.tldr: Boston faces Tuesday's 40-man roster deadline, with a group of ranked prospects needing to be protected before then.

stories.title: Jon Lester debuts on the Hall of Fame ballot, Pedroia returns for third year
stories.tldr: Jon Lester appears on the Baseball Hall of Fame ballot for the first time, with Dustin Pedroia back for a third year of eligibility.

finally.title: A short animation chronicles a life told through handwriting
finally.tldr: The short animation 'Paper Trail' traces the evolution of a young mind through the notes and lists it leaves behind, a quiet reminder of what handwriting can tell us about a life.
